title: Thinking-Free Policy Initialization Makes Distilled Reasoning Models More Effective and Efficient Reasoners
abstract: arXiv:2509.26226v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) effectively solves complex tasks but demands extremely long context lengths during training, leading to substantial computational costs. While multi-stage training can partially mitigate this, starting with overly short contexts often causes irreversible performance degradation, ultimately failing to reduce overall training compute significantly. In this paper, we introduce Thinking-Free Policy Initialization (TFPI), a simple yet effective adaptation to RLVR that bridges long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation and standard RLVR. TFPI employs a simple ThinkingFree operation, explicitly discarding the thinking content via a direct  append, to reduce token usage during inference. Training with ThinkingFree-adapted inputs improves performance and lowers token consumption, even in the original slow-thinking mode. translated_title: 无思考策略初始化使蒸馏推理模型成为更有效且更高效的推理器
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够有效解决复杂任务，但在训练过程中需要极长的上下文长度，从而导致巨大的计算开销。虽然多阶段训练可以在一定程度上缓解这一问题，但若从过短的上下文开始训练，往往会造成不可逆的性能退化，最终无法显著减少整体训练计算量。本文提出了无思考策略初始化，这是一种简单而有效的对RLVR的改进方法，在长思维链（CoT）蒸馏与标准RLVR之间架起了桥梁。TFPI采用一种简单的“无思考”操作，通过直接append的方式显式丢弃思考内容，从而减少推理时的token使用量。使用经过ThinkingFree适配的输入进行训练，即使在原始的慢思考模式下，也能提升性能并降低token消耗。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，TFPI……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出无思考策略初始化（TFPI），通过在RLVR训练中显式丢弃思考内容，使蒸馏推理模型在提升性能的同时降低token消耗，架起了长思维链蒸馏与标准强化学习之间的桥梁。
en_tdlr: TFPI introduces a simple ThinkingFree operation into RLVR training that explicitly discards thinking content, enabling distilled reasoning models to achieve better performance with lower token consumption, bridging long CoT distillation and standard RLVR.
